package build 3010 (M3 ACHIEVED: native G86 modeset - color bars on the panel)
  nvmini.vxd   39053 bytes
  nvprobe.exe  36352 bytes
  nvmini.drv   16158 bytes
nvprobe prints 'build: vxd=3010 exe=3010' when matched.

`nvprobe evoflip go` performs the full native takeover (verified on the T61,
2026-10-19): display-engine re-init, EVO core channel bring-up, complete
1024x768@60 head state, supervised commit (unk10/20/40 handshake), completion
notifier, scanout from our framebuffer at VRAM 16MB. The desktop is no longer
scanned out after a flip; recover with a cold boot. Diagnostic written to
nvflip.txt. Next milestone (E4): the display driver renders the Windows desktop
into the native framebuffer instead of a test pattern.
